name: 99026 · Nine Mile Fls, WA
findings: ZIP 99026 (Nine Mile Fls) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99026 (Nine Mile Fls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
